name: consts_Lhe

name: IDe

name: consts_action_mimes
purpose: DRAG MIME + ACTION-ID REGISTRY: $v="application/x-stage-action" (drag dataTransfer type); YSr=[rotate,revolve,scale-up,scale-down,transform,rig-transform] object actions (QSr=Set); xie=[still,path,follow,transform,manual,...bP] camera actions (JSr=Set)

name: t3r
purpose: t3r=Set(Lhe ids) — valid clip ids for payload parse

name: e3r
purpose: DRAGSTART SERIALIZER: {kind:"clip",clip}->"clip:<clip>"; {kind:"object",action}->"object:<action>"; {kind:"camera",action}->"camera:<action>"; else kind string (path/play)

name: MDe
purpose: DRAGOVER/DROP PARSER (inverse of e3r): "path"->{kind:"path"}, "play"->{kind:"play"}, "clip:<id>"->{kind:"clip",clip} iff t3r.has(id), "object:<a>"->{kind:"object",action} iff QSr.has(a), "camera:<a>"->{kind:"camera",action} iff JSr.has(a), else null

name: n3r
purpose: DEFAULT DURATION when dropped on a timeline lane: clip->N8(5s); object->transform|rig-transform?Jae(4s):N8(5s); camera->sje(action); else 0

name: sje
purpose: camera action default duration: _1[action].durationS (cinematic presets); path|manual->0; transform->Jae(4); else N8(5)

name: a$
purpose: DROP-COERCION RULE: action payload -> concrete action for object kind e ("cube"|"humanoid"|"camera"|...). camera kind: object-transform→camera-transform, path→camera-path (iff Q0(e)); humanoid: camera-path→path iff Q0, camera-transform→object transform iff Q0; rig-transform only humanoid; clips only via e==="humanoid" tail

name: bGt
purpose: normalize internal/legacy drag kinds to canonical payloads: rotate/revolve/scale(factor>=1?scale-up:scale-down)/transform/rig-transform/cam-still/cam-move{move}/cam-path/cam-follow/cam-transform/cam-manual

name: yGt
purpose: action equality (same kind+action/clip; path vs path always equal)

name: r3r
purpose: payload -> drop-target kind tags: cube-capable->"object", humanoid->"human", camera->"camera" (highlight bucket keys)

name: Art
purpose: can-add-action primitive: bGt(payload) -> a$(parsed, kind) !== null && yGt(parsed, coerced)

name: consts_bP
purpose: CINEMATIC CAMERA MOVES: bP=[orbit,dolly_in,dolly_out,dolly_zoom,crane_up,crane_down,spiral,pan_sweep]; YLe orbit-class; QLe vertical class; JLe dolly class; yP=bP minus pan_sweep; _1 presets {durationS,angleDeg,heightDeltaUnits,distanceScale}; s2r=10 a2r=120 fov clamp

name: eDe
purpose: smoothstep 0..1 easing for cinematic moves

name: i2r
purpose: fov clamp 10..120 deg (dolly_zoom guard)

name: KCe
purpose: CAMERA-MOVE POSE EVALUATOR: {kind,start,target,direction?,baseFovDeg,angleDeg?,heightDeltaUnits?,distanceScale?,t} -> {position,lookAt,fovDeg}; crane = vertical lift; dolly = radial scale + dolly_zoom fov compensation; orbit/spiral = polar sweep around target; pan_sweep = rotate lookAt around start

name: NDe
purpose: cinematic move -> i18n label: orbit k1ojqx, dolly_in DMQ5rS, dolly_out i7+TXP, dolly_zoom 2HQ6pZ, crane_up QQHcNA, crane_down 0+8v4P, spiral d8dJnh, pan_sweep DzL+ir

name: ODe
purpose: clip label fallback: t in PU ? i18n._(PU[t]) : t

name: F5r

name: consts_Brt

purpose: CALLER FACTORY: creates D5r (clip tiles) + H5r (object tiles) + y5r (camera tiles); ActionsPanel memo renders i.jsx(M5r,{show:!collapsed&&panelsVisible, onClose:toggleCollapsed, widthPx, onWidthChange:setWidthPx, drawTile/startTilePreview/stopTilePreview=e.*, drawObjectTile/...=n.*, drawCameraTile/...=r.*, onActionDragStart:setDraggingAction, onActionDragEnd:clearDraggingAction, canAddAction:id&&canDropActionOnObject(id,payload), onAddActionClick:id&&appendActionToObject(id,payload), onPathDragStart:t.onPathDrag, onPlayDragStart:t.onPlayDrag, requestedTab, selectedFigureName (simple_figure name||"Figure"), onSwitchToHumanClick:pickPersonKind(id,"humanoid","actions")}); disposeActionsPanel disposes all three

name: LU
